race.comment: TRUANT (6) resumes. He was firmly in the market on debut in a 2yo race won by star filly Natural Fling but failed to fire and was subsequently spelled. Tipping he'll be a sharp improver this time in off a good jumpout win. MR NATURAL (3) just missed another good filly on debut at Ballarat back in May, beaten a neck. He's another off a jumpout win who looks very well placed despite a wide gate. ROSEATIC (10) resumes having run fifth in a decent race on debut at Pakenham. She can progress this time in and figure prominently. CERTAIN IMPACT (1) has been fair in two runs on synthetic this time in and should be thereabouts. EXCLUSIVE PUNT (8) next best fresh.
